reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004E9EC0 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/004E9EC0-DefineTriggerOnce.cpp at sha256 b2c7b327e5b58681cbc8de5efec23b9f700bb5fec3aa94c8e1afce062f9e0a89 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineTriggerOnce(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, long param_7, int32_t param_8, void* param_9, float param_10);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

Single block 0x4E9EC0-0x4EA034: same shape as 0x4E8C60 with SoundSys_InitSoundSys_14/Sound_LoadSample, seven fstp qword stack spills from st0-st6, the [E+0x10] QVM frame and the 24-byte result record. The angr block-count difference is a granularity artifact of CFGFast splitting at call returns / rep movsd; the BN and radare2 block and edge tables are identical.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(long double arg1 @ st0, long double arg2 @ st1, long double arg3 @ st2, long double arg4 @ st3, long double arg5 @ st4, long double arg6 @ st5, long double arg7 @ st6, int32_t arg8, void* arg9, float arg10)" at 0x004E9EC0; radare2 recovers "fcn.004e9ec0 (int32_t arg_178h, int32_t arg_170h_2, int32_t arg_170h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x004E9EC0 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineTriggerOnce(long param_1, long param_2, long param_3, long param_4, long param_5, long param_6, long param_7, int32_t param_8, void* param_9, float param_10);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
